quests.title: One tower, on its own
quests.ask: Fill in `build_tower()`: standing on a site facing east, stack two gems straight above it so the tower is three tall, and end on the site facing east.
quests.nudge: Where it ends is where the walk along the street carries on. Trace the robot's way up and back.

quests.title: Build only on sites
quests.ask: Walk a short street with one site in the middle. Build a tower there, and leave the empty cells empty.
quests.nudge: As the robot arrives on each cell, what can it ask before it builds?

quests.title: Sites at both ends
quests.ask: Now the robot starts on a site, and there is another at the far end. Build both towers.
quests.nudge: The robot never moves onto its first cell. Does that cell still get looked at?
